name: Affictionate
source: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.
translation: 经过一年糟糕的约会和失败的工作申请，你几乎放弃了你一直在写的爱情故事。一天晚上，你把你的完美男人写进笔记本……第二天，他就变成了现实。一部关于身份以及虚构与现实之间界限的浪漫视觉小说。
